set.rappel_count_note: Several rappels from fixed stations where the south ridge steepens near the summit; a single 55 m rope is enough. No count or station positions are published. The slings are old, so inspect them and carry spare cord.
set.descent: Rappel and downclimb the upper south ridge to the notch at the top of the Barrier, then take the snow ramp into Crescent Creek Basin or reverse the Terror Glacier into Terror Basin.
